subject: ShellPkg/UefiShellLevel3: Extract ProcessFileList() function
reasons: Refactoring commit that extracts a new ProcessFileList() helper in Touch.c and Type.c
Function extraction — moving code into a newly defined function — is not expressible in SmPL; Coccinelle cannot create new function definitions
Although two files are touched, the extracted code differs between them and requires per-file judgment, not a uniform pattern
